#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
using ull = unsigned long long;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int ROOT = 3;

vector<ll> clean(vector<ll> a) {
    int len = a.size();
    while (len > 0 && a[len-1] == 0) len--;
    if (len == 0) return {};
    a.resize(len);
    return a;
}

vector<ll> mulnaive(const vector<ll>& a, const vector<ll>& b) {
    vector<ll> c(a.size() + b.size() - 1, 0);
    ll big = 8LL * MOD * MOD;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b.size(); j++) {
            c[i+j] += a[i] * b[j];
            if (c[i+j] >= big) c[i+j] -= big;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)c.size(); i++) c[i] %= MOD;
    return c;
}

ll modh(ll a, ll M, int h, int mod) {
    const ull mask = (1ULL << 31) - 1;
    ll r = a - ((M * (a & mask) >> 31) + M * (a >> 31) >> (h - 31)) * mod;
    if (r < mod) return r;
    return r - mod;
}

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll n, ll mod) {
    ll ret = 1;
    int x = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);
    for (; x >= 0; x--) {
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if (n >> x & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

ll invl(ll a, ll mod) {
    ll b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        ll c = a / b;
        ll d = a; a = b; b = d % b;
        d = p; p = q; q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

vector<ll> nttmb(vector<ll> src, int n, bool inverse, int P, int g) {
    vector<ll> dst = src;
    dst.resize(n);
    int h = __builtin_ctz(n);
    ll K = 1LL << (__builtin_clz(P) ^ 31);
    K <<= 1;
    int H = __builtin_ctzll(K) * 2;
    ll M = K * K / P;
    vector<int> wws(1 << (h-1));
    ll dw = inverse ? pow_mod(g, P-1 - (P-1)/n, P) : pow_mod(g, (P-1)/n, P);
    ll w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h-1)); k++) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P);
    }
    ll J = invl(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << i); j++) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << (h-i), t = s | (1 << (h-i-1)); k < (1 << (h-i-1)); k++, s++, t++) {
                ll u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2*P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2*P) dst[s] -= 2*P;
                ll Q = ((ull)u << 32) * J >> 32;
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h-1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h-i-2)); k++) wws[k] = wws[k*2];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = __builtin_rev(i) >> (32 - h);
        if (i < rev) swap(dst[i], dst[rev]);
    }
    if (inverse) {
        ll in = invl(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
    }
    return dst;
}

vector<ll> convoluteSimply(vector<ll> a, vector<ll> b, int P, int g) {
    int m = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size()) - 1)));
    m <<= 1;
    vector<ll> fa = nttmb(a, m, false, P, g);
    vector<ll> fb = (a == b) ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<int> d(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) cin >> d[i];
    vector<ll> f(20, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            f[10 + d[i] - d[j]]++;
        }
    }
    n /= 2;
    vector<ll> g = {1LL};
    for (int D = 17; D >= 0; D--) {
        g = clean(convoluteSimply(g, g, MOD, ROOT));
        if (n & (1 << D)) {
            g = clean(mulnaive(g, f));
        }
    }
    ll ans = (n * 10 < (int)g.size()) ? g[n * 10] : 0;
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
